desc: Build the exact HPM-only right-port host transition after 096/103/104 resolve forward and inverse semantics. Passive-sink detection must precede source/VBUS; target only nub-spmi-a1/hpm2 SID 0x0c. Include byte-exact rollback of every cache/config/role/VBUS change and bounded failure handling. Do not link eUSB2, ATC, DWC3/xHCI, Linux, block, or filesystem code. Produce source/disassembly/hash/reproducibility evidence and stop before live execution.
